candidate: vLLM Marlin GPTQ W4A16 full-vocabulary scan plus exact BF16 top-128 rerank
scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, max_num_seqs=1, greedy decode, vLLM fp8_per_block backbone

low_power_end_to_end_screen.protocol: same source, adjacent multiprocess runs, six natural prompts, one warmup and three trials, 128 generated tokens

non_comparable_prior_high_clock_baseline.reason: The current laptop was power limited to 780--975 MHz, so the low-power screen cannot establish speedup against the earlier high-clock frontier.

mtp1_screen.protocol: same candidate source in separate fresh processes, six natural prompts, one warmup and one measured trial, 64 generated tokens
mtp1_screen.reason: M=2 Marlin weight reuse is real, but it does not cover proposer, target verification, rejection, and runtime overhead; the M=2 backbone also changes numerical reductions before exact shortlist reranking.

implementation_limitations: Prototype quantization happens during first use and temporarily raises peak activation memory; production must load prepacked tensors.
The implementation imports a vLLM test packing helper and is therefore evidence code, not merge-ready production code.
The top-128 contract is bounded empirical greedy-token identity, not full-logit or all-input mathematical equivalence.
High-clock C-S-S-C qualification and a 512-case quality rerun remain required before promotion.
decision: Keep as the next ordinary batch-1 lm-head architecture candidate and reject MTP-1 at this deployment point. Do not replace the already qualified INT8+BF16 frontier until a power-controlled high-clock rematch passes.
